works.body:
Dear Mr. Yumikemuri
It is nice to meet you.

I fell in love with your very cute illustration and design at first sight (//∇//).

If it is possible, I would like to request a desing drawing of the outfit for my original character.

[Setting] ...
Short white hair with light blue gradient on the bottom.
Pink and light blue odd eyes.
Two moles under her right eye.
Cross earring on her right ear.
A cross earring in her right ear.
Cool type
Black cat/stuffed animal

Costume
I would like a black and white Lolita dress 🤍(I like ribbons, cats, butterflies, and tsuki).
I would like to have a headdress/bonnet hat ✨.

I would like to have a headdress/bonnet hat ✨.
I'll leave everything up to you!
I like this kind of composition 🤍.
https://x.com/1010yuge1010/status/1711310416050356297?s=46&t=PTHkva56qdWnxQDX6qHT5g

https://x.com/1010yuge1010/status/1925553618306093537?s=46&t=PTHkva56qdWnxQDX6qHT5g

Usage.
SNS icons/headers, iPad wallpaper, personal collection

Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fk3pYUJYnnE_ZrIfHNcwUgStik5N9vYh

Hi!

I discovered your art recently, and really really love your gentle and beautiful art style!

I was hoping you could make an illustration of my OC.
She is a living doll who designs and makes clothing as a way of remembering her dreams and emotions. She has the appearance of a ball jointed doll (BJD), with visible doll joints. 
She often appears calm and even emotionless, but is actually a very kind and caring person. 
Her main design motifs are butterflies and stars.

I would love for you to design an outfit for her if possible. I really love your design sense, so feel free to design as you'd like!
If possible, an illustration similar to this style would be great;
https://x.com/1010yuge1010/status/1757587021399576719
https://x.com/1010yuge1010/status/1747184708751093801

Feel free to change her hairstyle if you'd like to too!

This illustration would be for personal use only.

Thank you for your consideration!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ouq-vHpVFPdu-_pHTNMopHc-qOBjSmYe?usp=sharing

Can you please arrange my child Alice-chan 🐰🎩 in Yuge-sama's flavor...!

I'd like to change the coloring of her clothes to monochrome two-tone, and add the joker + killer rabbit element to the card game.
Please transform her into a bad, bad, bad joker 🐰🎩🃏 that seems to take life by pranks!

Weapon(?) I'd be happy if he switched from 🌂 to a sickle or ✂️ too!

https://imgur.com/a/RtYWuGD

Yumikiri Kemuri-sama, it's nice to meet you!
I saw you in the new arrivals and I'm so excited to meet you, so I'd like to have you as my child, please!
https://imgur.com/a/RtYWuGD

I'd like to make a picture of a naughty bunny girl with an Alice motif, but I'd be happy if it's in a calm and chic way.
I'll leave the pose and composition up to you!
